notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files:
  - Scene, HUD, input, main lifecycle: game/main.tscn + game/game_manager.gd
  - Player automatic run, gravity flip, rotation, collision detection, movement: game/player.gd
  - Platform metadata and scoring helper: game/platform.gd
  - Package marker: game/__init__.py
- State ownership:
  - GameManager (game_manager.gd): owns game state (playing/game_over), score, list of platform nodes, restart logic, HUD updates.
  - Player (player.gd): owns velocity, gravity direction, rotation tween, detection of being 'on' a platform; communicates events to GameManager via get_tree().get_current_scene().
  - Platform (platform.gd): owns its width/height, scored flag; GameManager queries platforms to award points.
- Interfaces:
  - GameManager.register_platform(platform: Node) -> void
  - GameManager.reset_game() -> void
  - GameManager.on_player_fell() -> void
  - GameManager.try_score_at(x: float, y: float) -> void
  - Platform.reset() -> void
- Coordinate convention:
  - 2D pixels, origin top-left; positive y = down. Player rotation_degrees=0 faces upright (gravity down). Flipped sets rotation_degrees = 180.
- Lifecycle:
  - init: main.tscn ready() registers platforms and player with GameManager; input actions added.
  - play: player moves right automatically; pressing Space flips gravity (prints FLIP GRAVITY). GameManager monitors scoring and falling.
  - terminal: on fall GameManager shows GAME OVER, prints "GAME OVER", stops player movement.
  - restart: pressing R calls GameManager.reset_game(), prints "RESTART", resets score to 0 and player/platforms.
  - quit: pressing Escape prints "QUIT" and calls get_tree().quit().

I'll now write the promised files and project.godot, then run syntax and boot checks.

--- game/platform.gd
+++ game/platform.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+class_name Platform
+
+@export var size: Vector2 = Vector2(200, 20)
+@export var is_ceiling: bool = false
+var scored: bool = false
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	# Request a redraw and create collision shape
+	queue_redraw()
+	_create_collision()
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	var col: Color = is_ceiling ? Color8(150, 50, 50) : Color8(50, 150, 50)
+	draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), col)
+
+func _create_collision() -> void:
+	# Ensure a StaticBody2D with CollisionShape2D matches the drawn rect
+	if not has_node("StaticBody2D"):
+		var sb := StaticBody2D.new()
+		sb.name = "StaticBody2D"
+		add_child(sb)
+		var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
+		shape.size = size
+		var cs := CollisionShape2D.new()
+		cs.shape = shape
+		sb.add_child(cs)
+		# position the collision shape to match the drawn rect (centered)
+		cs.position = size/2
+
+func reset() -> void:
+	scored = false
+
+func get_right_edge() -> float:
+	return global_position.x + size.x
+
+func get_rect() -> Rect2:
+	return Rect2(global_position, size)

--- game/player.gd
+++ game/player.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,101 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+class_name Player
+
+signal fell
+signal passed_platform(platform)
+
+@export var speed: float = 120.0
+@export var gravity_strength: float = 800.0
+@export var size: Vector2 = Vector2(32,32)
+
+var gravity_dir: int = 1 # 1 = down, -1 = up
+var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+var on_platform: bool = false
+var current_platform = null
+var start_position: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+
+const SPRITE_PATH := "res://game/assets/character_sprite.png"
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	start_position = position
+	# create a Sprite2D
+	var sp := Sprite2D.new()
+	sp.texture = load(SPRITE_PATH)
+	sp.centered = true
+	sp.scale = Vector2(size.x / sp.texture.get_width(), size.y / sp.texture.get_height()) if sp.texture != null else Vector2.ONE
+	add_child(sp)
+	set_physics_process(true)
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not get_parent().playing:
+		return
+	# horizontal constant movement to the right
+	position.x += speed * delta
+
+	# vertical velocity due to gravity
+	velocity.y += gravity_dir * gravity_strength * delta
+	position.y += velocity.y * delta
+
+	# Collision detection (manual snap to platform)
+	var gm := get_parent()
+	on_platform = false
+	current_platform = null
+	for plat in gm.platforms:
+		var r: Rect2 = plat.get_rect()
+		# check horizontal overlap
+		var px_left := position.x - size.x/2
+		var px_right := position.x + size.x/2
+		var overlap_h := (px_right > r.position.x) and (px_left < r.position.x + r.size.x)
+		if overlap_h:
+			if gravity_dir == 1:
+				# falling down: check if player's bottom is touching top of platform (allow small tolerance)
+				var player_bottom := position.y + size.y/2
+				var plat_top := r.position.y
+				if player_bottom >= plat_top - 2 and player_bottom <= plat_top + 50 and velocity.y >= 0:
+					# snap to platform top
+					position.y = plat_top - size.y/2
+					velocity.y = 0
+					on_platform = true
+					current_platform = plat
+					break
+			else:
+				# gravity up: check if player's top touches bottom of ceiling platform
+				var player_top := position.y - size.y/2
+				var plat_bottom := r.position.y + r.size.y
+				if player_top <= plat_bottom + 2 and player_top >= plat_bottom - 50 and velocity.y <= 0:
+					position.y = plat_bottom + size.y/2
+					velocity.y = 0
+					on_platform = true
+					current_platform = plat
+					break
+
+	# Check passing platform for scoring
+	if current_platform != null:
+		if position.x > current_platform.get_right_edge() and not current_platform.scored:
+			emit_signal("passed_platform", current_platform)
+
+	# Check fall off screen
+	var viewport_size := get_viewport_rect().size
+	if position.y - size.y/2 > viewport_size.y or position.y + size.y/2 < 0:
+		# Fell off screen
+		emit_signal("fell")
+
+func flip_gravity() -> void:
+	gravity_dir *= -1
+	# smooth rotate
+	var target := 0.0
+	if gravity_dir == -1:
+		target = 180.0
+	else:
+		target = 0.0
+	get_tree().create_tween().tween_property(self, "rotation_degrees", target, 0.15)
+
+func reset() -> void:
+	position = start_position
+	rotation_degrees = 0
+	gravity_dir = 1
+	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+	on_platform = false
+	current_platform = null
+	set_physics_process(true)

--- game/game_manager.gd
+++ game/game_manager.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+class_name GameManager
+
+@export var playing: bool = true
+var score: int = 0
+var platforms: Array = []
+var player = null
+
+@onready var score_label: Label = $HUD/ScoreLabel
+@onready var game_over_label: Label = $HUD/GameOver
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	# Ensure input actions exist
+	if not InputMap.has_action("flip"):
+		InputMap.add_action("flip")
+		var ie := InputEventKey.new()
+		ie.physical_keycode = KEY_SPACE
+		InputMap.action_add_event("flip", ie)
+	if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
+		InputMap.add_action("restart")
+		var ir := InputEventKey.new()
+		ir.physical_keycode = KEY_R
+		InputMap.action_add_event("restart", ir)
+	if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
+		InputMap.add_action("quit")
+		var iq := InputEventKey.new()
+		iq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
+		InputMap.action_add_event("quit", iq)
+
+	# gather platforms and player (children of this node)
+	platforms.clear()
+	for child in get_children():
+		if child is Platform:
+			platforms.append(child)
+			# allow platform to draw/collision to initialize
+			child.queue_redraw()
+		elif child.name == "Player":
+			player = child
+
+	# connect player signals
+	if player != null:
+		player.connect("fell", Callable(self, "_on_player_fell"))
+		player.connect("passed_platform", Callable(self, "_on_player_passed"))
+
+	update_score_label()
+	game_over_label.text = ""
+	playing = true
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("flip") and playing and player != null:
+		player.flip_gravity()
+		print("FLIP GRAVITY")
+
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+		reset_game()
+		print("RESTART")
+
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+		print("QUIT")
+		get_tree().quit()
+
+func _on_player_passed(platform) -> void:
+	if platform and not platform.scored:
+		platform.scored = true
+		score += 1
+		update_score_label()
+
+func _on_player_fell() -> void:
+	# End the run
+	if not playing:
+		return
+	playing = false
+	# stop player from processing
+	if player:
+		player.set_physics_process(false)
+	# show game over and final score
+	game_over_label.text = "GAME OVER\nSCORE: %d" % score
+	print("GAME OVER")
+
+func reset_game() -> void:
+	score = 0
+	for p in platforms:
+		p.reset()
+	update_score_label()
+	if player:
+		player.reset()
+		player.set_physics_process(true)
+	game_over_label.text = ""
+	playing = true
+
+func update_score_label() -> void:
+	score_label.text = "SCORE: %d" % score
+
+# Utility registration method if a platform chooses to call it
+func register_platform(platform: Node) -> void:
+	if platform not in platforms:
+		platforms.append(platform)

@export var speed: float = 120.0
@export var gravity_strength: float = 800.0
@export var size: Vector2 = Vector2(32,32)

var gravity_dir: int = 1 # 1 = down, -1 = up
var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var on_platform: bool = false
var current_platform = null
var start_position: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

const SPRITE_PATH := "res://game/assets/character_sprite.png"

func _ready() -> void:
	start_position = position
	# create a Sprite2D
	var sp := Sprite2D.new()
	sp.texture = load(SPRITE_PATH)
	sp.centered = true
	sp.scale = Vector2(size.x / sp.texture.get_width(), size.y / sp.texture.get_height()) if sp.texture != null else Vector2.ONE
	add_child(sp)
	set_physics_process(true)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not get_parent().playing:
		return
	# horizontal constant movement to the right
	position.x += speed * delta

	# vertical velocity due to gravity
	velocity.y += gravity_dir * gravity_strength * delta
	position.y += velocity.y * delta

	# Collision detection (manual snap to platform)
	var gm := get_parent()
	on_platform = false
	current_platform = null
	for plat in gm.platforms:
		var r: Rect2 = plat.get_rect()
		# check horizontal overlap
		var px_left := position.x - size.x/2
		var px_right := position.x + size.x/2
		var overlap_h := (px_right > r.position.x) and (px_left < r.position.x + r.size.x)
		if overlap_h:
			if gravity_dir == 1:
				# falling down: check if player's bottom is touching top of platform (allow small tolerance)
				var player_bottom := position.y + size.y/2
				var plat_top := r.position.y
				if player_bottom >= plat_top - 2 and player_bottom <= plat_top + 50 and velocity.y >= 0:
					# snap to platform top
					position.y = plat_top - size.y/2
					velocity.y = 0
					on_platform = true
					current_platform = plat
					break
			else:
				# gravity up: check if player's top touches bottom of ceiling platform
				var player_top := position.y - size.y/2
				var plat_bottom := r.position.y + r.size.y
				if player_top <= plat_bottom + 2 and player_top >= plat_bottom - 50 and velocity.y <= 0:
					position.y = plat_bottom + size.y/2
					velocity.y = 0
					on_platform = true
					current_platform = plat
					break

	# Check passing platform for scoring
	if current_platform != null:
		if position.x > current_platform.get_right_edge() and not current_platform.scored:
			emit_signal("passed_platform", current_platform)

	# Check fall off screen
	var viewport_size := get_viewport_rect().size
	if position.y - size.y/2 > viewport_size.y or position.y + size.y/2 < 0:
		# Fell off screen
		emit_signal("fell")

func flip_gravity() -> void:
	gravity_dir *= -1
	# smooth rotate
	var target := 0.0
	if gravity_dir == -1:
		target = 180.0
	else:
		target = 0.0
	get_tree().create_tween().tween_property(self, "rotation_degrees", target, 0.15)

func reset() -> void:
	position = start_position
	rotation_degrees = 0
	gravity_dir = 1
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	on_platform = false
	current_platform = null
	set_physics_process(true)

extends Node2D

class_name Player

signal fell
signal passed_platform(platform)

@export var speed: float = 120.0
@export var gravity_strength: float = 800.0
@export var size: Vector2 = Vector2(32,32)

var gravity_dir: int = 1 # 1 = down, -1 = up
var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var on_platform: bool = false
var current_platform = null
var start_position: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

const SPRITE_PATH := "res://assets/character_sprite.png"

func _ready() -> void:
	start_position = position
	# create a Sprite2D
	var sp := Sprite2D.new()
	sp.texture = load(SPRITE_PATH)
	sp.centered = true
	if sp.texture != null:
		sp.scale = Vector2(size.x / sp.texture.get_width(), size.y / sp.texture.get_height())
	add_child(sp)
	set_physics_process(true)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not get_parent().playing:
		return
	# horizontal constant movement to the right
	position.x += speed * delta

	# vertical velocity due to gravity
	velocity.y += gravity_dir * gravity_strength * delta
	position.y += velocity.y * delta

	# Collision detection (manual snap to platform)
	var gm := get_parent()
	on_platform = false
	current_platform = null
	for plat in gm.platforms:
		var r: Rect2 = plat.get_rect()
		# check horizontal overlap
		var px_left := position.x - size.x/2
		var px_right := position.x + size.x/2
		var overlap_h := (px_right > r.position.x) and (px_left < r.position.x + r.size.x)
		if overlap_h:
			if gravity_dir == 1:
				# falling down: check if player's bottom is touching top of platform (allow small tolerance)
				var player_bottom := position.y + size.y/2
				var plat_top := r.position.y
				if player_bottom >= plat_top - 2 and player_bottom <= plat_top + 50 and velocity.y >= 0:
					# snap to platform top
					position.y = plat_top - size.y/2
					velocity.y = 0
					on_platform = true
					current_platform = plat
					break
			else:
				# gravity up: check if player's top touches bottom of ceiling platform
				var player_top := position.y - size.y/2
				var plat_bottom := r.position.y + r.size.y
				if player_top <= plat_bottom + 2 and player_top >= plat_bottom - 50 and velocity.y <= 0:
					position.y = plat_bottom + size.y/2
					velocity.y = 0
					on_platform = true
					current_platform = plat
					break

	# Check passing platform for scoring
	if current_platform != null:
		if position.x > current_platform.get_right_edge() and not current_platform.scored:
			emit_signal("passed_platform", current_platform)

	# Check fall off screen
	var viewport_size := get_viewport_rect().size
	if position.y - size.y/2 > viewport_size.y or position.y + size.y/2 < 0:
		# Fell off screen
		emit_signal("fell")

func flip_gravity() -> void:
	gravity_dir *= -1
	# smooth rotate
	var target := 0.0
	if gravity_dir == -1:
		target = 180.0
	else:
		target = 0.0
	get_tree().create_tween().tween_property(self, "rotation_degrees", target, 0.15)

func reset() -> void:
	position = start_position
	rotation_degrees = 0
	gravity_dir = 1
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	on_platform = false
	current_platform = null
	set_physics_process(true)

+		var overlap_h := (px_right > r.position.x) and (px_left < r.position.x + r.size.x)
+		if overlap_h:
+			if gravity_dir == 1:
+				# falling down: check if player's bottom is touching top of platform (allow small tolerance)
+				var player_bottom := position.y + size.y/2
+				var plat_top := r.position.y
+				if player_bottom >= plat_top - 2 and player_bottom <= plat_top + 50 and velocity.y >= 0:
+					# snap to platform top
+					position.y = plat_top - size.y/2
+					velocity.y = 0
+					on_platform = true
+					current_platform = plat
+					break
+			else:
+				# gravity up: check if player's top touches bottom of ceiling platform
+				var player_top := position.y - size.y/2
+				var plat_bottom := r.position.y + r.size.y
+				if player_top <= plat_bottom + 2 and player_top >= plat_bottom - 50 and velocity.y <= 0:
+					position.y = plat_bottom + size.y/2
+					velocity.y = 0
+					on_platform = true
+					current_platform = plat
+					break
+
+	# Check passing platform for scoring
+	if current_platform != null:
+		if position.x > current_platform.get_right_edge() and not current_platform.scored:
+			emit_signal("passed_platform", current_platform)
+
+	# Check fall off screen
+	var viewport_size := get_viewport_rect().size
+	if position.y - size.y/2 > viewport_size.y or position.y + size.y/2 < 0:
+		# Fell off screen
+		emit_signal("fell")
+
+func flip_gravity() -> void:
+	gravity_dir *= -1
+	# smooth rotate
+	var target := 0.0
+	if gravity_dir == -1:
+		target = 180.0
+	else:
+		target = 0.0
+	get_tree().create_tween().tween_property(self, "rotation_degrees", target, 0.15)
+
+func reset() -> void:
+	position = start_position
+	rotation_degrees = 0
+	gravity_dir = 1
+	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
+	on_platform = false
+	current_platform = null
+	set_physics_process(true)

--- game/game_manager.gd
+++ game/game_manager.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+extends Node2D
+
+class_name GameManager
+
+@export var playing: bool = true
+var score: int = 0
+var platforms: Array = []
+var player = null
+
+@onready var score_label: Label = $HUD/ScoreLabel
+@onready var game_over_label: Label = $HUD/GameOver
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	# Ensure input actions exist
+	if not InputMap.has_action("flip"):
+		InputMap.add_action("flip")
+		var ie := InputEventKey.new()
+		ie.physical_keycode = KEY_SPACE
+		InputMap.action_add_event("flip", ie)
+	if not InputMap.has_action("restart"):
+		InputMap.add_action("restart")
+		var ir := InputEventKey.new()
+		ir.physical_keycode = KEY_R
+		InputMap.action_add_event("restart", ir)
+	if not InputMap.has_action("quit"):
+		InputMap.add_action("quit")
+		var iq := InputEventKey.new()
+		iq.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE
+		InputMap.action_add_event("quit", iq)
+
+	# gather platforms and player (children of this node)
+	platforms.clear()
+	for child in get_children():
+		if child is Platform:
+			platforms.append(child)
+			# allow platform to draw/collision to initialize
+			child.queue_redraw()
+		elif child.name == "Player":
+			player = child
+
+	# connect player signals
+	if player != null:
+		player.connect("fell", Callable(self, "_on_player_fell"))
+		player.connect("passed_platform", Callable(self, "_on_player_passed"))
+
+	update_score_label()
+	game_over_label.text = ""
+	playing = true
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("flip") and playing and player != null:
+		player.flip_gravity()
+		print("FLIP GRAVITY")
+
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+		reset_game()
+		print("RESTART")
+
+	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+		print("QUIT")
+		get_tree().quit()
+
+func _on_player_passed(platform) -> void:
+	if platform and not platform.scored:
+		platform.scored = true
+		score += 1
+		update_score_label()
+
+func _on_player_fell() -> void:
+	# End the run
+	if not playing:
+		return
+	playing = false
+	# stop player from processing
+	if player:
+		player.set_physics_process(false)
+	# show game over and final score
+	game_over_label.text = "GAME OVER\nSCORE: %d" % score
+	print("GAME OVER")
+
+func reset_game() -> void:
+	score = 0
+	for p in platforms:
+		p.reset()
+	update_score_label()
+	if player:
+		player.reset()
+		player.set_physics_process(true)
+	game_over_label.text = ""
+	playing = true
+
+func update_score_label() -> void:
+	score_label.text = "SCORE: %d" % score
+
+# Utility registration method if a platform chooses to call it
+func register_platform(platform: Node) -> void:
+	if platform not in platforms:
+		platforms.append(platform)
